annotations.title: Find a benefits or P&C workflow

description: Search a built-in library of benefits and P&C workflows, including renewal comparison, census cleanup, SBC comparison, loss-run summary, quote comparison, and COI review. Returns matching workflows with steps and a starter prompt.

limit.description: How many matches to return, from 1 to 5. Defaults to 3.

line_of_business.description: Optional filter: benefits, pc, both, or any.

query.description: Words to search for, such as census, SBC, loss run, quote, or COI.

name: find_workflows
title: Find a benefits or P&C workflow
